paper_title: Token-Level Uncertainty Estimation for Large Language Model Reasoning
caption: Left: Uncertainty estimation with different perturbation strength _q. Right: Influence of perturbation strength on uncertainty-based AUROC scores.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between perturbation strength and uncertainty estimates for four different variables: AU, TU, and EU. The x-axis represents perturbation strength, denoted as σq, and displays a linear scale ranging from 0.02 to 0.5, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.02. The y-axis represents a value, with a scale ranging from 0.05 to 0.20, also in linear increments. The red line, representing AU, begins at a value of approximately 0.18 and decreases gradually to approximately 0.15 throughout the x-axis. The blue line, representing TU, starts at approximately 0.12 and rises to approximately 0.19 at x = 0.5. The green line, representing EU, begins at approximately 0.15 and steadily increases to approximately 0.20 throughout the x-axis.
